0022600175.text: The Celtics, playing at home, are 5-1 and riding a five-game winning streak. They sit 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, while the Bucks are 1-5, have lost two straight, and are 5th in the Central and 14th in the East. Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest) are out for Boston, and George is averaging 20.7 points and 31.0 minutes per game this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 133-101 win in Milwaukee on April 3.
